spec2def(xinput1_1.dll xinput1_1.spec)

# xinput1_1.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/xinput1_1-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(xinput1_1_shims OBJECT xinput1_1_main.c)
target_link_libraries(xinput1_1_shims PRIVATE libxinput1_3 libmsvcrt libkernel32)
set_wine_module(xinput1_1_shims)
add_cargo_module(xinput1_1 xinput1_1-cargo xinput1_1.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xinput1_1_shims psdk)
